Principle 1:Self-introduction
Nice to meet you sir. It’s a pleasure to be with you today.
First of all, thank you for giving me a chance to introduce myself.
My name is Hong-gil-dong, and I live in Seoul.
I live at Han-guk apartment.
I am a 4th grade student at Han-guk Elementary School.
I’m a 3rd year middle school student at Han-guk Middle School.
I am 11 years old.
I am a very outgoing person, but I am also a little shy around new people.
I have a lot of friends.
I love to be around my friends, and they like to be around me.
I’m a pretty happy person. Most people like me.
I’m kind of a shy person.
Even though I am afraid to talk a lot around people,
everyone says I am a very likable person and fun to be around.
Most people like me after they get to know me.
My hobbies include reading books, listening to music, hiking, watching
movies, and participating in sports.
I especially like watching movies.
I like to play computer games as well.
I study many different subjects at school,
but my favorite subject is English.
I study English everyday. I have been studying English for 3 years so far.
I like studying English because it is fun and exciting to learn.
I like to help other people, individually.
When I help others, it makes me happy.
I like to volunteer at the orphanage and help the children there.
Volunteering at the orphanage is an exciting time for me.
